[CONSENT ITEMS]
BPW-2026-0470
BSS
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – USA WASTE OF CALIFORNIA, INC. DBA WASTE MANAGEMENT
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report with transmittals to the Mayor and City Council, with the request that the Board of Public Works be authorized to execute the revised Personal Services Contracts with USA Waste of California, Inc. dba Waste Management; Arakelian Enterprises, Inc. dba Athens Services; California Waste Services, LLC, and Cordova Rentals, Inc. dba Cordova Construction Services for the Recycling and/or Disposal Services of Clean and Mixed Inert Debris, Clean and Mixed Construction and Demolition Debris, Bulky Items, White Goods, and Mixed Debris with a revised term of five years with one five-year renewal option; and
EXECUTE the contracts, by the President or two members of the Board, upon Mayor and City Council authorization.
​​(W.O.: M0010011)
summary: Request authority to execute revised Personal Services Contracts with waste disposal service providers.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED - REFERRED TO MAYOR AND CITY COUNCIL, FORTHWITH
